decision: Retain the validated physical pISO correction and close this bounded trial without an accepted aggregate core-versus-cusp conclusion.
reason: The corrected core has a positive aggregate held-out predictive advantage under both kernels, but NGC5585 fails the prespecified conditional predictive-adequacy check for both physical halo families.
numeric_caution: Dynesty evidence errors estimate integration uncertainty, not global convergence guarantees. Direct importance integration has very low effective sample size for NGC5585 and differs by up to 1.23 nats. Its aggregate contrasts are 5.4940 and 2.0931 nats, with the latter reversing the small NGC5585 sign. It does not replace the primary score, but the nominal evidence threshold/sign-count is not numerically certified. The present runs also fail predictive adequacy; no accepted physical discrimination is established and no stronger numerical certification is required for this nonacceptance decision.
observational_scope: Three metadata-selected SPARC reduced rotation curves; 60 outer training bins and 19 reserved inner bins. DDO154 is development-only. No new observations or interventions.
continuation: End case selection and this allocation. Preserve correction, original source, inputs, fits and failure evidence. Programme evaluator retains decisions on any new allocation.
old_R3_anMC_status: Scoped recipient rejection and sampler preserved; not reopened or used in this independent trial.
